requirement.statement: The system SHALL provide a `/domain-workbench` application surface that lists registered DomainContext bundles, shows read-only model sources, groups semantic resources, and lets users filter operations by owner, behavior, subject, invocation, and effect without editing Kon model source.

case.given: the production server registers the reference bundles
case.then: the workbench SHALL load both bundle ids and select a stable default bundle

case.given: a selected bundle catalog with Kon model sources
case.then: the model text SHALL be visible as read-only content and no upload or recompile control SHALL be exposed

case.given: the operation catalog contains BO, association, lifecycle, constraint, process, capability, domain-context, and raw owners
case.then: the visible operation list SHALL update without mutating the selected preset request

requirement.statement: The workbench SHALL use the preset's complete `ExecuteOperationRequest` as the preview JSON and as the submitted body; editing JSON SHALL update that exact object or surface schema/catalog diagnostics without maintaining a second hidden request model.

case.then: the JSON SHALL include apiVersion, context, operation, invocation, and execution exactly as a directly POSTable request body

case.given: a user edits only business payload or execution observe channels within contract rules
case.then: the workbench SHALL POST the edited JSON body unchanged and browser tests SHALL assert the network request body

case.given: a user edits a catalog-owned field such as operation ref or verb into a mismatch
case.then: the workbench SHALL surface the returned validation or catalog diagnostic and SHALL keep the edited preview visible

requirement.statement: The workbench SHALL execute selected requests through `POST /api/domain-operations/execute` and render the response envelope through distinct views for outcome, changes, before/after, operation tree, plan or SQL availability, and diagnostics, including partial batch item mapping when present.

case.given: a write preset with before, after, diff, trace, and plan observation channels
case.then: status, outcome, mutation summaries, probe snapshots, operation tree, public plan, and diagnostics SHALL be inspectable

case.given: a best-effort batch preset with one failing item
case.then: the response SHALL show partial status and stable item keys for success and failure rows

case.given: a business execution failure preset such as CancelRepair failure
case.then: failure diagnostics and the visible child-operation prefix SHALL be rendered without treating HTTP 200 as success-only UI state

case.given: runtime response facts mark SQL trace or batch item mapping unavailable
case.then: the workbench SHALL display the unavailable diagnostic or mapping state and SHALL NOT fabricate SQL or item outcomes

requirement.statement: The workbench SHALL remain usable on desktop and mobile widths, preserve the existing Kon IDE route, avoid overlapping controls or text, and pass Playwright E2E coverage for catalog loading, request preview, execution, diagnostics, and responsive layout.

case.given: the existing Kon IDE remains mounted at `/`
case.then: both surfaces SHALL render their own controls and existing Kon E2E tests SHALL remain green

case.when: the workbench renders catalog, request, and response panes
case.then: primary controls and text SHALL fit without incoherent overlap

case.given: Playwright observes browser network and console events
case.when: workbench E2E cases load catalogs and execute presets
case.then: the tests SHALL assert expected request bodies and SHALL fail on unexpected console errors

case.given: the web-ide production build and E2E webServer setup
case.then: the UI SHALL typecheck/build and use only public web-shared and contract APIs
